title: My game just went live on Google Play: a word puzzle with falling letters, chain reactions and a rising floor
author: NSTStudios
selftext:
Hi folks! After months of evenings and weekends, my word game Gravity! The Word Game is live on Google Play. I built it while working full time as a project manager, studying for my PMP certification, and being a father and husband.

Without AI, this would never have been possible. Claude helped find bugs, control consistency (eg. game rules across the games when I changed one aspect of how the game works) and up until the last moment was helping me resolve a bug that only happens on the release build and was never detected in any debug build prior. 

**How it plays:** letter blocks wait at the top of a starfield. You move, rotate and drop them to spell words across or down. When a word clears, the letters above fall and can form new words, setting off chain reactions. Every 1,000 points a rock floor rises and your space shrinks, until you reach the Event Horizon, where gravity finally takes hold.

I’ve put a lot of effort and thought into making it a complete game, with different modes, ranks, daily challenges, achievements and more. It took a lot of trial and error. Up until the last few days before launch I was still making major changes, second-guessing myself about what works and acting on what my testers were telling me. And frankly, without Claude, this would have been impossible. For example:

* My first version had blocks falling on a timer. Testers said it felt stressful, so in 2.0 the blocks wait for you, and the pressure comes from the rising floor instead.
* One of the daily puzzles, Orbitle, was too hard at first. One tester went 23 guesses without solving it, so I added word ideas, a “Show me” walkthrough and clearer clue explanations.
* A release build crashed on a step that worked perfectly in debug builds. Tracking it down took a phone bug report and a lot of head-scratching. I was lucky to catch it.

It’s free, and I’d really love feedback: what’s confusing, what’s fun, what you’d change. First impressions of the tutorial and Orbitle would be especially useful. **The current version has no ads and no payments. There’s an in-game currency for unlocking modes and cosmetics, but it’s all earned through play.**

👉 [https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.norahlyn.gravity](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.norahlyn.gravity)

  
See trailer here: [https://youtube.com/shorts/VeoHTngQQzk?feature=share](https://youtube.com/shorts/VeoHTngQQzk?feature=share)

Thanks for reading!
